newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- Feb 7.

text.p: * American Express Co shares were up 1/2 at 62-1/2 in London on a Wall Street Journal report that the U.S. Justice Department was preparing to file an anti-trust suit against VISA USA and MasterCard International for barring member banks from issuing American Express and Discover cards.
* International Business Machines Corp, which dropped 2-3/4 on the New York Stock Exchange Thursday, was up 3/8 to 146 in London.
* Intel Corp was up 1/2 at 153-5/8 in London.

* Lincoln National Corp reported fourth quarter earnings per operating share of $1.22, against 0.09 after a charge a year earlier. The First Call estimate was $1.12. The stock closed at 53-1/2 Thursday.
* CVS Corp has agreed to acquire Revco D.S. Inc in a stock swap, the Wall Street Journal said. The merger would create the second-largest drug chain in the United States behind Walgreen Co, it said.
CVS closed at 44. Revco closed at 38.
